name: Project portfolio status roll-up
summary: The head of delivery takes one page to leadership each fortnight or month, built from the reports project leads already write: every project red, amber or green as its own lead stated it, what moved, the decisions leadership is asked for, and where two reports contradict each other or a status has no reason.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own method for rolling the project leads' status reports into one page for leadership: each status copied as its lead stated it, unanswered decisions carried forward by number, contradictions between reports quoted side by side without taking a side, and the head of delivery's confirmation before the page goes.
